review_description: The installation crew were very efficient, although not the fault of the installers, the system should have a shroud/cover to cover the wires, it looks very untidy between the batteries and the inverter
Gus from MLEC was really helpful in getting the system designed and providing expert knowledge to help us get the right setup for our home.

The sales and quoting process was smooth and hassle-free, which was the main reason I chose MLEC. The installation team was professional and efficient, they handled the grid connection, tested the blackout function, and provided a clear introduction to using the app.

Sales and quoting process was very smooth, the Sales Rep came in personally. He had very good knowledge about the product. Installation was punctual, tidy and polite.  The grid connection was done on the spot by qualified installer and explained very clear.

The sales and quote were quick.  Saleperson was very responsive and helpful.  Installation was quick and without hassle, no fuss.  The solar system started working well and the installer ran everything through with us.  And everything has worked well so far.

great response during the sales processexcellent installation, tidy polite and prompt.turn key solution, including grid connection and all communications with SynergyLooking forward to phase 2, which includes additional panels, battery and EV charger.

Everything was undertaken in a very understanding, courteous and helpful way at the quoting stage and indeed all the way through. The installation happened on schedule and we were shown how to use the system

This installer was the only one that came to the house. They discussed the shading issue I have and made recommendations which were in line with research I had done.Install went well and they have shifted a tv antenna which would shade the panels free of charge and organised grid connection. I will use them to install a battery once details on the rebate are clear.
Sales/quotation/Installation/customer service/grid connection excellent in all respects.

Great company to deal with. Very fast and well organised. Installers were fast and efficient. They broke a couple of tiles but replaced with the spares.Electrician spent time going through the inverter settings and app.

Excellent service from MLEC. They were prompt, the sales guy was fantastic and informed me about the system and how it would help.The installers were friendly, efficient and fast. Great system I am very happy.

Sales and quoting - quick turn around from requesting to having formal quote. Didn't talk me into more than I needed, actually talked me into a smaller system that suited my house - but was upgradable easily if I wanted. Not often salesmen try to talk you out of spending more.Install was clean and tidy, done over two days as expected. Looks great. First time they'd installed a zappi charger so unfortunately lost all paperwork for that system(warranty, instructions ECT).Installers were friendly, talked me through where everything would go and made sure I was happy with itAfter install care has been good so far, issues with zappi which they came and addressed within 48hrs of me calling. Still awaiting email and documents regarding warranty for the zappi they accidentally threw out though.Overall can't complain at all. Quality system with a clean and tidy install. No dodgy cheap gear sold by this team. Only quality. Have recommended to my friends and colleagues. Can see why 2 of my colleagues recommended them to me also.
Everything went smoothly from the moment when we sat down with Darren to the query after the installation on how to read the app. Thanks

MLEC Solar installed a 9.6kW (Panels) / 5kW inverter & 10kWhr SAJ H2/B2 system at my property in Perth.System has performed exceptionally well as expected and my first full bill which was $700 last year is on track to be less than $60.On all but the hottest days the system allows me to be self sufficient including EV & Pool Pump.Very impressed with MLEC, after talking to a number of installers who were scared off by a flat concrete second story roof  MLEC were happy to work with me to ensure the installation was appropriately waterproofed and no additional cost from the facebook advertised price even with second story & an installation with meter board & inverter / battery on opposite sides of the house.

Installation day the boys arrived on time and got into it rather quickly awesome bunch of guys and respectful also once finished they cleaned up their mess then answered all questions before moving off the property...Customer service I must say was very functional and resourceful no matter the queries before and after installation evert question was met with a polite and in a manner so as you understand the process..Thanks again awesome.

We recently purchased a solar system through MLEC Solar Perth and are very happy with the overall experience. There was a bit of miscommunication at the beginning, but after contacting them again with the help of SolarQuotes, things were quickly resolved.  Out of the four companies I contacted, MLEC was the only one that took the extra step of sending someone to check my house before the installation. Darren came out, clarified all my doubts, and helped me choose the best option for my needs.The installation team also did an excellent job. Everything has been working exactly as promised so far. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend MLEC Solar to anyone considering solar!
Quoting process was clear.Installation engineers were polite with great communication.

The Sales, timing, Installers proved excellent. Exactly what we asked for in our request for quote: site visit, options for systems, good price and installation in two weeks with no requirement for a deposit. Everything was on time, in time and everyone was helpful. Thanks for your great support and service.

We went with Jinko panels and a Sungrow inverter. The system was installed promptly and is working much better than anticipated. Especially since it was installed in winter. We have been surprised by the amount of kwhs generated despite cloudy or even rainy days.MLEC was very friendly, helpful and professional during the whole process. Minor hiccup was sorted promptly
The quote was done over the phone, the salesman didn't come out to my place as requested. The installation was punctual. Customer service was good and they organised the grid connection.
Very happy with the whole service from start to finish.

The MLEC care team were brilliant,  especially Luke, who was amazing, caring and went above and beyond. What ever luke is being paid is not enough.The ceiling was replaced by Jaimie, who was very skilled with Luke assisting him, and painted by a professional painter.Luke returned after the painter and fixed a minor issue with the plaster immediately and also checked in after the work was completed.The Inverter installer, James was also professional and thanks also to Darren for getting the care team on site on the Sunday when the damage first started,I went from 1 star to 4 1/2 as there followup work was amazing, it's just disappointing that an employee would've known he broke a tile which resulted in a lot of people being displaced.Was also a shame, management did not personally followup with my initial calls to apologise and when repairs would commence   which i had to make several calls  for.I would have no issues recommending MLEC,
From start to finish I was not troubled in any way

The sales person contacted us by phone with initial questions, then we arranged a site visit. The sales person listened to us, answered our questions and we settled on an outline of what we wanted to have installed. The finished quote was completed within a day after a few goes back and forth working out finer details.The installation was on time, though unfortunately the same day as the first significant rain we had for a few months. Most of the indoor work was finished, but it wasn't safe to work on the roof so the day was cut short. The crew was back a few days later to complete the installation. The finished work was neat and tidy.MLEC took care of all the connection approvals.
Very happy with the installation.  The team were very professional and tidy with their work.The whole process was very easy and everything was handled by the installation company.
Installation was fast and efficient. Our tradesmen were considerate, tidy and polite. Took away all the old 3.5Kw system, gave us instructions on the inverter WiFi app.

Excellent process from start to finish. Spoke to 2 sales people that visited the house. They did a thorough review of our needs, made some recommendations and we purchased the system.Installation was booked and the technicians arrived on time on the day. Very tidy and professional.They showed me the app, installed and system runs like a charmHighly recommended.
Very happy with our solar installation. The whole process was smooth and efficient and the resultant system is exceeding our expectations.

I was really impressed with this company. They came out to quote and were happy to discuss different systems, why they recommended some over others and answer any questions I had. The installers were equally professional and did a great job. The back up service afterwards when I had a question was also fabulous, quick and efficient. I would highly recommend this company!
The title says it all. MLEC were the most honest, sincere, comprehensive quote process. I had many questions and had no problems getting through to them and they took the time to answer everything.

Quick and responsive quotes, including a detailed discussion about what we need now and what the future plans may be.Installation was quick and efficient. Communication was great all through the process.
10 Out of 10.Top of the wozza!!!!!Excellent overall.Highly recommend this company
A few issues after installation, one solar panel cable laying on tin roof and 5 solar panels frames cracked on corners, they claim it won’t effect longevity of solar panels.

Sales quoting process good. He answered all my many questions. Installation was good till before the commissioning.Tech was polite, but he didn't know how the western power required device works. I had to download the instructions from the internet (he could do the same, it's his job). He took more than 2hrs to understand that he plugged a cable in the wrong port on the inverter, and bc of that the system wasn't working. If i didn't check the production on the app he would have left telling me to call the company the day after for any issues. He didn't know that the inverter, once the 3kw limit had been set up, works at steps. Finally they sold me the monitoring Device required by western power as a power limiting Device, it is actually a power meter, and $500 more for that, are a bit too much. Installation time 15 minutes.

I am very impressed by the installer Shane and Harry. They are on time and with yesterday heat in Morley of 42 degrees, they just get on with the job done very professionally. They are very good workers and your company should be proud of them.

Professional, no nonsense, from quote to completion of installation and commissioning. Three weeks from quote to operation of our system with all applications, approvals and connections as part of the service. System producing between 30 and 40 units per day depending on weather.
Despite a last minute hitch, which they came back within hour to fix, the team did a professional job I can recommend them for their level of service

Sales process was great.  They were the only company that actually really listened to what I wanted and it was never a hassle to ask one more question.  More than happy to provide comparable quotes so I could work out how they costed out compared to theirs ((made it so much easier to cross check quotes).  Came straight out to do a sight visit the moment I asked.Install was seemless.  Rocked up on time.  Install is neat and tidy.  Walked me through what was going to happen and didn’t pick up a tool until we were all happy things were going to go to plan.  Checked in with me the whole time.I did nothing about the grid connection (besides show them a copy of out bill), they handled everything in the back end for me.
MLEC were super easy to deal with from initial chat with salesman right through to prompt installation time and very professional installation guys.

Highly recommend this company.   Very professional in every way.   This was the fourth property I have had solar panels installed on and the third one with batteries, so am reasonably familiar with the technology and as a retired electronics engineer with a background in sustainability and renewable energy, I can voucher for the competency and integrity of this company.
Quick service and install- also explained a battery was not right for me - just got yhe 13.2Kw system
Sales Person, Tim was good to deal with, very friendly and provided good and thorough advice & opinions.Design and layout was good.Installation was prompt, efficient, efficient & neat and tidy.

I decided to go with MLEC after 3 different quotes because they were the first and only company who would not provide a quote without sighting my property - significant due to building heights and shadowfall. From start to finish, the staff were friendly, professional and knowledgeable. I was also impressed with the business ethic of this 'small' and well established company, who offer not only parts warranty, but also 20 years service warranty. I cannot believe any company would survive for the time they have if they had to return and repeat labour for many of their installations!I would definitely recommend this group to family and friends.

Recently had a solar system installed at my home. Thought everything went well, after installation installer said everything was set up and safe to use. After a week I decided to call synergy to confirm all was okay, they have informed me they had no idea I had the solar system installed, they then mentioned that I hadn't had the meter upgrade and it is unsafe to run the system while using this old meter. The installer had not mentioned this at all, and as previously mentioned had said everything was ready to go and the system was all good to run. I have tried to contact the company about this but still am waiting to hear back after a week.Not impressed at all, especially considering I would've had no idea to turn the system off unless I called synergy.
Excellent priceGreat quality productExcellent warrantyCame out to house and explained everything clearly
The installation went very smoothly and professionally.  Both were very informative and professional.  Highly recommended MLEC Solar.

Out of the 3 other local solar companies I engaged only MLEC was willing to come out to our home to provide a quote. The whole experience from the sales consultant visit through to the system being install just two later was a breeze. Communication throughout was great and the in-house installation team were amazing; efficient, polite and extremely tidy and they set up and fully explained the app for the system.System performance has been great and we are now really starting to see the real financial benefits with our power bills reducing by over 60%. Extremely happy with MLEC and would highly recommend.

I recently had the pleasure of working with the MLEC team for my solar and battery installation needs. I would like to give a special shoutout to Jake, who I believe was the team leader. Jake demonstrated a remarkable level of dedication and skill in ensuring that everything was completed to perfection. The entire team impressed me with their work ethic and commitment to excellence.Furthermore, Karim, the sales consultant, was extremely practical throughout the entire process and provided invaluable assistance. I greatly appreciated his helpfulness and guidance.Overall, I highly recommend the MLEC team for their outstanding work and exceptional customer service. If you are in need of solar and battery installation services, look no further than the MLEC team.
Generally a good service across the board, provided an excellent solution to my requirements.

The electrical contractor sent to install my system has somehow managed to surge the power while drilling into the wall during installation and damaged a number of appliances in the house including a very costly chlorinator which has a completely fried circuit board due to a power surge. Mlec is refusing to acknowledge this damage as their responsibility suggesting it was probably just a coincidence. Highly recommend keeping clear of this business.
Solar panels were installed today and we are very happy with the whole process. Very professional and efficient.

MLEC was referred by a neighbour. The sales rep. was prompt, very informative and investigated possible problems concerning installation of solar cells and inverter to our preferred location, before providing a quote which compared favourably to 3 other installers. Installation within 2 weeks of the quote, was done in 2 days by efficient, neat, competent, friendly people and matched exactly that proposed by the sales rep. The installer explained personally the use of the monitoring app (on my iPhone). All requirements regarding connection to the grid were completed by MLEC.

Their consultant was very approachable, knowledgeable and happy to assist, I’m on a carers allowance and my Wife is on sickness benefits so finding finance for anything is 'difficult'. after a few dead ends the consultant found a lead that 'may' be successful (which it was!) he went out of his way to help - even with after hours calls. As soon as finance was approved a date for installation was set! The Installation team was working in the area and finished a job so called me to see if they could arrive early, after a quick friendly chat I instructed them where I would like the inverter then left them to it, they did their reconnaissance and made it happen! From my perspective all I had to do was say yes or no and provide my details and the MLEC team took care of ‘everything’ else, it couldn’t have gone smoother! A big thanks to the MLEC team, we wanted solar for many years and they made it happen, very professional, the product and the process was high quality.

We decided on a solar and battery option. We liked the Solar Edge system we chose because we can add onto it in the future should we decide to get an electric vehicle for example.  We’ve only had the system for a couple of weeks and have been tracking our usage via the app with great interest.
Mlec was prompt to quote, followed up and had the system installed in under 3weeks.

MLEC we’re very good in terms of information supplied and the quote was very competitive.  All quotations missed the fact that whilst I have 3 phase power at the meter and in my workshop, my house was only single phase.  MLEC arrived on time, with a 3 phase inverter but this was identified and rectified immediately with no delay in the installation.  The price was then adjusted accordingly.Installation was quick and effective.

Luke visited us and delivered us a truthful quote on a large system and battery with option of more batteries, Luke is one of the best reps I have delt with which will sit well with MLEC.I had a 10kw and battery system fitted which matched with the 3 phase of my house, the teams that fitted the system were very helpful, polite, but most of all the quality of workmanship was to a very high standard, the sparky advised I needed some extra devices to prevent panel string drop out due to shade, had them fitted,.The system has now been working for my property  and providing electrical power and I should see the benifits of the system for the future.With the app you get real time generation and power consumption for the property and battery state which will help the home owner use power wisely and leisurely, well worth the expense as it will take a few years to pay it self off but in the long term good for me.The inverter and battery set is neat in appearance not overly large fits in well with the house outside decor.The inverter is a very radio quiet unit with minimal spurious noise for AM and hf, short wave reception.All in all I would recommend MLEC for a solar system.The only dampener was MLEC were held up by the power company and govt by fitting monitoring devices to inverters and taking their time.Once cleared from power company holdups and govt red tape MLEC set a install date and did the job to perfectionI will consider a second battery
Had to get them to come back after install to fix incorrect inverter setupworking good now.
Everything went very well and a very smooth and professional process.
Installation amazing.  Arrived on time, completed the task, and were gone.  All lads very polite and did over and above what was expected.

After spending $30000 on a solar installation, And explaining what we will be using this for they installed a system, and it's costing me more now.They throw their shoulder up and says Mate it's done and they installed the system, Have never experienced such bad service in my life.I will NOT recommend them at all they have no idea what they doing and the electricians have no knowledge of working out the usage needed.

Not happy with how they have installed our solar, rang and told them to basically been told to deal with it not happy at all, installers have left wire and rubbish in our garden and on the roof.Cables in conduct outside and all saddles not evenly space with different screws in each saddle, to pay for what we got is just really poor on workmanship and not professional as they say.
Solar quotes provided me with great information regarding Solar and as such helped e make an informed decision about install company
On site quote, explained what I needed to know, arrived on time and polite, everything was organized, install team arrived on time and finished earlier than expected.

Quote was clear and prompt. I signed agreement with Now Solar but installation was completed by MLEC.Installers were polite, tidy and punctual.  Panel layout was not done according to diagram which was dissappointingas it reduced exposure to sunlight. Fronius inverter malfunctioned on second day throwing RCD. Crew attended later that day and checked that all was safe. New unit will be installed 1 week after incident.MLEC organized the grid connection which was done on same day as installation

I don't want to sound like the President of their Fan Club however Ben and his team, Jake, Mass and Simon are a great specialist crew that arrived when they said and did the job like they said they would.It is very difficult to get professional tradies out in the bush.Nothing was a problem for these guys.They are polite and left the site clean.The installation even looks good and very neat.We are breathing new life into a forgotten and abandoned homestead in the Australian outback and we recommend these guys if you want to reduce your power bills and carbon footprint like we have.

MLEC sent out their sales rep and installation expert, a week before installation, and we spent a whole 2 hrs with him. He was very good, and explained everything in detail.What impressed us most was, he pulled up the Google satellite views of the house roof, and went to great pains to produce his software programme, whereby he could measure and position the panels on the roof.We have had trouble with shading of the 8 panels on the rear of the house in Winter, with the previous 1.5Kw system, so we ensured the new panels for the MLEC 6.6Kw system were positioned, spread over the rear and NW side of the house.Lo and behold, their installation team turn up, and they position 12 of the 18 panels on the rear of the house - lower down than the previous panels - where they can get fully shaded in Winter!There was no consultation with us as regards positioning, no reference to anything that the installation rep had drawn up!We wasted a whole 2 hours of installation designing, all for nothing!The system is working O.K. for now, because it's Spring, and we don't have shading problems at present. But come Winter, we'll probably be down 20% or 25% on power generation, because of the poor panel positioning!I personally think this company is pretty average as regards meeting customer satisfaction.The office sent out "warranty and data" information - which wasn't attached to the email! I had to tell them they'd forgotten to attach it - so another person sent it - and all it was, was a factory panel and inverter brochure!No-one has contacted us to ask if we're happy with the completed installation, or whether there are any problems. So follow up with this company is non-existent.The system is supposed to be 5Kw, but we've never seen more than 4.85Kw generated in the 5 days since it was installed - and the system has been in full sun and we had a 33 deg day.The "Solarman" app that MLEC provide for wireless connection is pretty useless, you can't adjust any settings on it, you can't enlarge any of the graphs to see the fine detail, it's the most pathetic app I've encountered in a long time.Overall, I'd give this company a 3 out of 5, and I'll be surprised if they're still in business in 5 yrs time - meaning our 20 MLEC warranty is probably pretty useless.
Well done team!! Very smooth and efficient, tidy, punctual and quick process throughout!! Darren was very knowledgeable, friendly and patient with us! Thank you Darren :)

The sale process was okay.  Should have put more emphasis on back up strategy and expectations during a grid outage.Installation team (ended up with 3 different groups) were all great.  Professional and listened to all concerns.Customer service is average.  I had some issues with the product from day 1 and it took longer to be resolved then it needed to take.  However, in the end I got what I wanted and am very happy.
Very professional sales person.   After a few hiccups, the installation was installed to our satisfaction.   The installers were all polite and tidy and everything so far seems to be going well.
Quotation was excellent, installation forgot to hand paper work over and cut half of the house power off due to one wire in the incorrect spot.

Got messed around trying to schedule a site visit, it was all set for a Saturday then just prior got told they don't do Saturday meetings in person.Other than that it all went well, just waiting for the WiFi setup to happen so we can see if the system is working.Salesperson was good to deal with, install was neat and timely.

Sales and quoting was very prompt with very competitive pricing. The tiles on our roof are not very robust and hard to find replacements indeed we couldn’t find any prior to the install. Inevitably installation resulted in quite a few roof tiles broken but MLEC were able to very quickly find replacements (when we could not) and replace the broken tiles. All staff were very friendly and cleaned up to a high standard. Would recommend.
Fantastic service, friendly and reliability on time clean and tidy after installation.

Shannon was great to deal with. She looked at what our bills were and broke the bill down to show us what we could expect. The installation guys were good, slight issue with polarity error but easily fixed. Overall happy with the service and price.
Installers were punctual and efficient. Customer service was excellent including follow up calls. Very happy with the system.

Installation cut 2 holes in our ceiling and also cut a hole in our brand new corrugated roof which they did not tell us. Good thing the air-conditioning Installation guys seen it and took photos and told us straight away as there was rain coming.Took ages to get through to anyone to help us and they would never leave a message when returning your call. I emailed them plenty of photos and there was only one customer service lady that actually went out of her way to help.Over a month after Installation they finally sent someone to fix the roof which consisted of a bit of tin screwed over the top of the hole.... what a bunch of cowboys. Now we have to get the original roofers in and pay them to fix it.Really annoyed that we had paid them before they fixed their stuff ups as I would honestly get them to remove it all and go with someone else.

Hi Guys,I have just had my solar installed and would like to express my thanks to the team, really professional, first class job and friendly, and all has been a hassle free experience well done MLEC would recommend you to anyone.RegardsTony Green

I had already researched my options so had a good idea prior to the salesman visit.  Very accommodating with my requirements no problems with a couple of changes to panel layout.  Due to the SENEC V3 being a relatively new product to their range there were a couple of issues with the extra smart power backup but resolved without problems.Really clean installation as the SENEC V3 is a combined inverter/battery and freestanding.
Easy to deal with.Installers were polite and punctual.Everything was organized for grid connections.

Brendan made the entire enquiring, decision making and installation process easy and enjoyable.  He kept in regular communication, answered our queries as they arose, dealt with the technical and practical aspects of having our solar system installed and took the uncertainty out of the process for us.  The installers were efficient, capable and polite. Being able to pay off the purchase price in instalments was a significant bonus.  We genuinely recommend MLEC.

Sales and quote process was greatInstallation was very good though started a couple hours earlier than planned because of hot day I assumeCustomer service was really good and honestGrid connection was seamless

I'm fussy, We have just built a brand new house that has taken 9 months to design and 2 years as is a custom build and I am like i said fussy on everything.After speaking with the Sales team, I was assured that the quality of the installation would be excellent and I would be involved in the discussion on where everything, ie location of inverter, panels and most importantly conduits and cable runs would be.I was assured via an email that the installation would be up to my (high) standard I have an email from management assuring me of this prior to installation.I have to say that the installation guys where as was promised especially Mark, everything was as I asked forno exposed conduits all cables run in cavity walls to a high standard.I'm am an Engineer and understand what can and can't be done.I would highly recommend this company and that is saying something from me as i'm very fussy.Please see pictures of inverter like i said no exposed conduits or cables very nice job.Mark even went to level of re-aligning labels on the inverter because they where not 100% level and he wasn't happy with the way they looked.

MLEC were very professional from the salesman through to the receptionist and very easy to deal with, The installation team was on time and very efficient. I would recomend them for any installation..
everything was organised by them and went very well..all of the above was brilliant

MLEC, Your team was efficient, courteous and paid attention to detail.Your communication with us was excellent. Well done or having such a great team and Leadership. We will be recommending you to anyone who requires a solar system in future. Keep up the great work.

Unbelievable first rate service and professionalism from my Design Consultant. He made the whole process a breeze and I couldn't be happier with the Solar System I purchased or the Installation that will surely be first rate. Easily a total of 5 stars for all aspects here. Totally awesome!

Great value, great service, good people and professional. i will be recommending/referring MLEC to family and friends.Tristain (sales) - An honest and proactive sales man. Not many sales people these days put the customer solution before the sale.Ben (Operations) - problem solver, pragmatic with customer needs as a priority.Mat and Wolf (install) - Very polite and although the install was tough (old building) - there were very polite, happy and very professional.Jake and Trent (install and commissioning) - The equipment supplier stuffed Jaime about for a few days but he was very persistent, kept me up to date and ensured everything works. Trent was also very polite, friendly and professional.Tee (Customer Service)- always kept me uptodate and no problem was too bigThank you MLEC and keep up the good work.
Paid a fair price for best option and got the quality of service I sought.

The Mlec quote was basically identical to the other company and included the removal of my old system. The Inverter was the same although the panels used were slightly smaller in output but of similar quality. The company arrived on time on the designated day and although the installers experienced difficulties and were unable to uninstall the old system they arranged for a another day and all went wellI felt very comfortable with this company and the service provided

MLEC does seem to have some issues with their scheduling. No one showed up for the first meeting with the sales consultant. When I notified them, they were very apologetic. The second appointment was fine. The installation team turned up 5 days earlier than I was informed that they would be onsite. As it turned out it didn't matter so the system was installed earlier than I was expecting.The installation went very smoothly. There was an old system that had to be removed first and I was charged a very nominal fee for the removal of that system. I was expecting it to be more expensive.Overall I am very happy with the system that has been installed. 6.5Kw of Sunpower P series panels and a 5Kw 3 phase SMA inverter. It has been generating on average between 35-40Kwh per day (cool sunny days).

Update to review, 26/10/2020:So to update where I am with MLEC - Tuhira from MLEC contacted me on Wed 21 Oct to apologise for my requested service going unanswered. In the course of our conversation it became apparent he was reading from my initial review with Solar Quotes (he mentioned the three star rating) so I can 100% endorse the effectiveness of the feedback process. Tuhira admitted they had no record of my phone call and he could not find my email with screen prints to their Customer Service email address - but they had also not realised my bill was unpaid! I forwarded him my original email so he could see the email address used, and when it was originally sent.Tuhira attempted to walk me through a solution but it simply wouldn't work (phone app and Fronius webpage both denied I existed!). So he despatched Robyn out to my house the next morning and after about an hour of toing and froing, phone calls to Tuhira, they eventually managed to get my inverter connected and talking to the app. I waiting 24 hours to make sure it was stable before I settled my account.Original review:Installed on 24 Sept but app has never worked and inverter shows as offline on the Fronius website. Phoned MLEC for assistance on 29 Sept (under their much vaunted 48 hr service guarantee) and was promised a call back. Followed up with an email to their customer service email  address, complete with screen prints outlining the problem.  Have not heard back since. Luckily I have so far only paid them a deposit ($500) with $5k still outstanding - I'm sure they will contact me at some stage to get their money. Which they will not be getting till these problems have been rectified.

Friendly sales person, very well informed and not pushy. I felt comfortable asking questions and he took the time to explain everything. Installation went as planned, the guys turned up on time were polite and friendly and cleaned up afterwards.

We had Brendan, he was fantastic, he sat us down and drew diagrams and explained everything to us in plan that my husband understood. He was on time and very helpful and friendly.The installation was meant to be a 2 day job but they finished it in one day. Very happy. Polite, tidy and yes on time.Not sure on what the grid connection part means sorry.
Quoting process was very thorough. Had a few issues with supply and changing layouts but all went well. Good service from MLEC.

Sales staff were very professional and responsive. Answered all my questions and provided a system at the price point I was seeking. The installation team were also very professional, arrived on time and were flexible with placement of both the panels and the inverter.
Very happy with seamless service from quote to install.  Install team were neat, efficient and friendly.
Sales person was nice and knowledgeable, installation quick and without hitch
Sales process was great, installation was great. Communication could be improved slightly.
They were all very good. Knowledgeable and helpful. All kept their appointment times.

I had done quite a bit of research before meeting with Steve so I knew exactly what I was after. They arranged everything with synergy and western power and arrived on time 2 weeks later for installation which went very smoothly. The guys were super friendly and did a professional, tidy job.
